input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets (and in places exceeds) the preferred position: six months of transition assistance on request following expiry or termination for any reason, priced at the expiring Order Form rates rather than Vendor's then-current rates (favourable to us); return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and no data hostage for fee disputes; and secure deletion only after we confirm successful return, with written officer certification and continued protection of any legally required retained copy. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return data). Nothing to redline.
